title: The Mushroom House Orchestra: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: It was a sunny morning when Rosie visited Mimi.
Mimi was making pancakes in her kitchen.
Mimi filled a little jar with dried beans.
Pip is a tiny brown mouse.
The hedgehog brought a shiny silver bell.
When Mimi waved her spoon slowly, everyone played loudly.
What did the rain tap on?
items.why: “Rain tapped softly on the big red roof.”

items.q: What did Rosie use as a drum?
items.why: “Rosie found a wooden bowl and began to drum.”
“Pip brought two acorn shells and clicked them together.”

items.q: Who flew in through the open window?
items.why: “Then a cheerful robin flew through the open window.”

items.q: What happened when everyone played at the same time?
options: The cups rattled on the shelves
items.why: “The music was so loud that the cups rattled on the shelves.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: On a rainy morning, Rosie and Mimi made music with spoons, a pot, a jar of beans and a bowl. Pip the squirrel, a hedgehog and a robin joined them, but at first everyone played at the same time and made only noise. Mimi used her spoon to lead them, and they made real music together.

items.q: What did Rosie and Mimi use to make music?
items.model: Spoons, a little pot, a jar of dried beans and a wooden bowl.

items.q: Why did Mimi say, "Nobody is listening"?
items.model: Because everyone was playing at the same time. The music was so loud that the cups rattled on the shelves.

items.q: How did Mimi help the friends make real music?
items.model: She waved her spoon. When she waved it slowly, everyone played softly. When she waved it quickly, everyone played faster.

items.q: What can you use at home to make music?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Rain tapped on the big red roof
Rosie found a wooden bowl and began to drum
The cups rattled on the shelves
The orchestra played outside for the forest animals
